summary: Overlap prepared Qwen GDN MXFP8 input projections through 1023 rows
compatibility: Uses the existing Qwen overlap setting and prepared stream/workspace owners. Non-MXFP8 and larger prefill paths retain their existing scheduling.
details: Paired B12X MXFP8 projections can overlap in eager execution and captures above 16 rows.
The caller stream joins the auxiliary stream before returning either output. GPU correctness and performance qualification are recorded separately.
